correctness.rationale: Exact Zak multiplier from Parseval; theta entire function has one simple zero per period; elliptic logarithmic-derivative difference has exactly two zeros at u=0,1/2 and both force c=0. With c nonzero no simultaneous Zak zeros. At beta=pi the sole zero at c=0 has positive definite two-coordinate Hessian. Real-analytic minimization and reflection give exact positive anisotropic coefficients and O(|c|^4). CHECK.py passed 162 finite numerical consistency assertions; these do not replace analytic infinite proofs.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Lemvig requires q-p>degree, violated by 2-1=1 for degree one. Liehr–Shafkulovska–Taylor requires q>=np+2, violated by 2<3. Ulanovskii–Zlotnikov provides existence of some failing polynomial, which is consistent with the present c=0 exception, and does not force all c to fail. Odd-window obstruction covers c=0 only. None implies the full iff classification or leading sharp phase constants.
